correctness.rationale: PASS. The exact specified unitary and CPTP environment reset leave vacuum plus one-excitation block invariant; the ground input stays vacuum and the excited-input reduced population p_n gives exactly their trace distance. Tracking P,Q,Im coherence gives the stated real 3×3 recurrence. Its characteristic polynomial at ε0 is (x²−λ)(x+λ); for each fixed λ in (0,1) the three roots √λ,−√λ,−λ are distinct and analytic in ε near0. First-order derivatives yield r+−|r−|∼[(1+6λ+λ²)/(1−λ)] ε times appropriate scaling; the two oscillatory eigenweights tend to 1/2 and the third to0. Even-index increments stay negative; odd-index increments switch at nε=K(√λ) by comparison of a strictly decreasing ratio of leading positive/negative modes, with third-mode remainder uniformly controlled by O(ε)q^n. Counting every other index yields the asserted K/2 coefficient; positivity at exact SWAP alternates indefinitely. Independently checked nine characteristic polynomials and six bounded trace-distance revival counts against the limiting scale at ε=.002,.001,.0005 for fixed λ, without inferring the limit from finite time. This is a pointwise fixed-λ local result: at larger ε the eigenstructure may differ and is outside scope.
